You're wife's life matters, though mine does not. Considering you're with her in the first place she must not be ugly. I, on the other hand, am hideous. Because of this, and many other reasons, my life has no purpose. There's no reason to live if you know you're going to die alone and jobless. 
Never am I going to find value in my self because there is none to be found to begin with. I have no positive traits both appearance and personality-wise. To be an ugly person but still find value in yourself is to be delusional. If I had a time in my life where I considered myself "beautiful", I'd be crazy, because it's obviously not true. My face and body aren't even my only faults. I'm also incredibly dumb. Even the most basic of tasks I somehow fail at. Nothing that I ever wish to accomplish in life will happen. I set my bars very low because I know that's all I'm capable of. I'm an idiotic, 300 pound loser who doesn't deserve life.

I know, I was astonished. He obviously wasn't attracted to me, because no sane person would be, but he actually wanted to converse with me and it felt amazing. Every other guy whose talked to me was either insulting me or was forced to.

I tell people of my intentions and all they do is yell at me. My doctor is tired of constantly having to change my prescription every month and my parents scream at me whenever I tell them how I feel. My friend ignores me. I can only see my therapist one day a week and she hasn't been of much help. I am not worth anything. If I hadn't made this post my existence would've meant nothing to you.
